title: The Echo of the Kuiper Line
author: Astrid Almeida
blurb: Vesper Pemberton, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
